question: Revise peers-paseo-rule-matches-practice at ideation to relax the clause? FO recommends revise; approving accepts it: when the transport is confirmed Paseo, a new ask is allowed without listing paseo, so adopters not on Paseo have no binding at all (answering his 「不是每個人都要 paseo」, ADR 0038); this reverses ADR 0038's chosen option through a new ADR; validation runs one real two-agent ask, reply and notice, which he authorizes; check that notifyOnFinish false does not silence an errored peer.
